title: Abba, Son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Sotah 49a. Rav Huna found a fat date and gave it to Rabbah his son. Abba his son came, and Rabbah gave it to Abba. And Rav Huna said to his son, 'You have gladdened my heart and set my teeth on edge' — but Hyman infers from Rashi that his reading was simply 'his son came' (without the name Abba).
